summary: This script connects to an FTP server, navigates to a specific directory, and downloads all PHP files from it to a local folder. It's automating a file retrieval task that would otherwise require manual steps in an FTP client.

explanations.1: Changes the local working directory to c:\temp, so any downloaded files will be saved there.
explanations.3: Opens an FTP connection using embedded credentials in the URL—the username, password, and server address are all specified inline.
explanations.7: Sets the transfer mode to ASCII, which means text files will be converted to the local system's line-ending format (as opposed to binary mode, which copies bytes exactly).
explanations.9: Downloads all files matching the *.php pattern from the FTP server's current directory to the local c:\temp folder; the -filemask flag filters which files to grab.
